answer: The nonce chain allows at most 3 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own tide record, and its own share of the horizon quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The pulse ledger enforces the limit at intake. A farm of 2584 identities would post 4115 proofs and burn roughly 30 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
